detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Monk mode isn't a week offline. It's one job with an end time you wrote down first.

"Deep work this morning" turns into email by 9:40 because nothing said when it stops.

Before you start, take two minutes: write "Until 11:00: draft the budget section" on paper. Phone in a drawer in another room. Close every tab that isn't for that job.

At 11:00, stop and write the next step. A short block you finish beats a long one you abandon.

#focus #productivity
